svg.aria-label: Open Memory Lab: Steady at the centre. Forming at the edges.
svg.title: Open Memory Lab: Steady at the centre. Forming at the edges.
svg.desc: Open Memory Lab. Steady at the centre. Forming at the edges. Shared memory for AI agents and crews. Nothing joins until someone other than its writer has looked, and every decision stays on record. Open source, AI-first, human in the loop. Illustration: the foundation as a star with shared vocabularies and whole datasets on orbits, a fenced experiment, a growing outer arc, and a companion star giving a second look to a body waiting to join.
